design_detail: Registry homepage (MGH National Pregnancy Registry for Psychiatric Medications website)
population: Pregnant people exposed to psychiatric medications (registry webpage; no data in file)
sample_size_detail: Website citation only; no study data in file
rationale: Citation-only file; ACOG cites the registry's web page (accessed 2023), a registry homepage rather than a study report.

design_detail: AHRQ Comparative Effectiveness Review No. 236: systematic review of perinatal pharmacologic interventions for mental health disorders; 4 databases to June 2020, surveillance to March 2021, dual screening
comparison_group: Placebo, no pharmacotherapy, discontinuation before pregnancy, or other pharmacotherapy
population: Pregnant, postpartum, or reproductive-age women with mental health disorders treated with pharmacotherapy
sample_size_detail: 164 studies (168 articles); total pooled participants not reported in abstract
rationale: AHRQ evidence report with systematic searches and dual screening; includes placebo-controlled trials (e.g., brexanolone) and observational harms studies (abstract: more than 95 percent of harms studies observational).

design_detail: Population-based register cohort linking maternal health data and prenatal SSRI prescriptions to neonatal birth records, 1998-2001; propensity-score matching of SSRI exposure in last 14 days vs exposure stopped earlier
severity_measure: Abstract states PS matching controlled for maternal illness severity (total SSRI exposure, maternal health characteristics); specific variables not listed
comparison_group: SSRI-exposed neonates whose exposure stopped before the last 14 days of gestation (NL14)
population: SSRI-exposed neonates in linked population health/birth records, 1998-2001
sample_size_detail: 119,547 = all linked neonatal birth records (source population); sizes of L14 and NL14 SSRI-exposed groups not given in abstract
rationale: Non-randomized comparison of late vs earlier-stopped SSRI exposure with propensity score matching; conclusion says results held after 'controlling for maternal illness severity', but the exact severity variables are not in the file.

design_detail: Hospital-based cohort (maternity ward of a general hospital, 2007-2012) of infants exposed to antidepressants in third trimester; risk-factor analysis for poor neonatal adaptation (odds ratios)
severity_measure: Abstract does not state whether ORs are mutually adjusted; maternal anxiety/depression listed among analysed risk factors but how measured is unclear
comparison_group: Within exposed infants: formula vs breast/mixed feeding; SSRI vs SNRI; antidepressant dose
population: Infants exposed in utero to antidepressants during last trimester, one general hospital, 2007-2012
sample_size_detail: 157 of 247 (64%) developed PNA
rationale: Observational risk-factor study among exposed infants only; abstract lists factors analysed but never mentions multivariable adjustment, so coded as unadjusted with severity Unclear.

design_detail: NICE clinical guideline CG192 (antenatal and postnatal mental health), with 2018 MHRA valproate update
population: Women planning pregnancy, pregnant, or within a year of birth with or at risk of mental health problems
sample_size_detail: Guideline; no sample
rationale: PubMed types Review and Practice Guideline; abstract describes scope of a NICE clinical guideline.

design_detail: Best practice guideline (Registered Nurses' Association of Ontario) on assessment and interventions for perinatal depression
population: Perinatal people with or at risk of depression (per title)
sample_size_detail: Guideline; no sample
rationale: Citation-only file; cited item is explicitly a 'Best practice guideline' web page.

design_detail: Cross-sectional 36-question mail survey of obstetrician-gynecologists on depression screening attitudes and practices; predictors of screening
comparison_group: None (predictors of screening practice among respondents)
population: Obstetrician-gynecologists responding to a mail survey
sample_size_detail: 282 respondents; number surveyed/response rate not in abstract
rationale: Clinician survey of attitudes and practices; no treatment comparison.

design_detail: Web page for Postpartum Support International frontline provider training program
population: Frontline providers caring for perinatal patients (training resource)
sample_size_detail: Website citation only; no study data in file
rationale: Citation-only file; cited item is a training program web page, which the protocol lists as a resource.

design_detail: Multiple-treatments (network) meta-analysis of RCTs of 12 new-generation antidepressants for acute unipolar major depression, 1991-2007; ITT
comparison_group: Other new-generation antidepressants (direct and indirect comparisons)
population: Adults with unipolar major depression
sample_size_detail: 117 RCTs; 25,928 participants
rationale: Abstract: 'systematically reviewed 117 randomised controlled trials (25 928 participants)' with network meta-analysis.

design_detail: Population-based descriptive study (self-described case series) of pregnancy-associated deaths from self-harm (suicide/overdose), Colorado 2004-2012; record abstraction; frequencies and death ratios per live births
severity_measure: Not applicable (purely descriptive; no comparative effect estimate)
comparison_group: None (descriptive context vs all Colorado women with live births)
population: Women with pregnancy-associated deaths from self-harm, Colorado, 2004-2012
sample_size_detail: 63 self-harm deaths among 211 maternal deaths; detailed records for 59 (31 overdose, 28 suicide); 614,154 live births used as context
rationale: Methods: 'Descriptive analyses were performed' on outcome-defined cases with population death ratios; coded descriptive observational rather than case series because cases are deaths (not exposure-defined) from statewide surveillance.

design_detail: Prospective clinical cohort, Perinatal Psychiatry Service, Hospital Clinic Barcelona, 2005-2008; factors associated with SSRI discontinuation on pregnancy confirmation
severity_measure: Mostly bivariate comparisons reported (EPDS/STAI higher in discontinuers); OR for unplanned pregnancy given, but whether any model adjusted for EPDS or other covariates not stated
population: Consecutive pregnant women with DSM-IV depressive or anxiety disorder taking SSRIs at conception, Barcelona 2005-2008
sample_size_detail: 70 discontinued, 62 maintained; 40 of 70 reintroduced treatment
rationale: Non-randomized comparison of discontinuers vs maintainers; abstract reports no-difference tests and a single OR without describing adjustment.

design_detail: Prospective naturalistic cohort at 3 specialty centers, 1999-2003; monthly SCID assessments; survival analysis of time to depressive relapse, discontinuers vs maintainers
severity_measure: Abstract reports HR 5.0 without describing covariates; cohort restricted to euthymic women with prior MDD (restriction on history only)
comparison_group: Women who maintained antidepressant medication throughout pregnancy
population: Pregnant women <16 weeks with prior major depression, euthymic >=3 months, on antidepressants at or shortly before conception
sample_size_detail: 201 enrolled; headline comparison 82 maintained vs 65 discontinued; 13 miscarried, 5 terminated, 12 lost, 8 withdrew
rationale: Non-randomized maintain-vs-discontinue comparison; the abstract gives a survival-analysis hazard ratio but no indication of covariate adjustment, so adjustment status and severity are uncertain.

design_detail: Program utilization and quality assessment of MCPAP for Moms (statewide perinatal psychiatry access program), June 2014-Dec 2017: encounter data plus provider focus groups and patient interviews (grounded theory)
population: Obstetric practices/providers and pregnant or postpartum women served by MCPAP for Moms, Massachusetts
sample_size_detail: 3,699 women served; 145 practices and 1,174 providers trained; 7,444 encounters; 3 focus groups (36 staff) and 10 patient interviews
rationale: Descriptive utilization data and qualitative themes with no comparison group or effect estimate.

design_detail: Updated systematic review with meta-analyses and mixed-treatment comparisons of second-generation antidepressants for MDD (literature 1980-Aug 2011); AHRQ-funded
population: Adults with major depressive disorder
sample_size_detail: 234 studies; RCTs >=6 weeks for efficacy and observational studies >=1000 participants for harms; pooled N not reported in abstract
rationale: Systematic review including randomized trials (efficacy) and large observational studies (harms).

design_detail: FDA drug safety communication (regulatory notice) on SSRI use in pregnancy and persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn
population: Pregnant women using SSRIs and their newborns
sample_size_detail: Regulatory web page; no study data in file
rationale: Citation-only file; an FDA drug safety communication is a regulatory notice (resource).

design_detail: Retrospective cohort nested in US Medicaid Analytic eXtract 2000-2010 (46 states + DC); primary analysis restricted to women with depression diagnosis; logistic regression with propensity-score fine stratification and high-dimensional PS
severity_measure: Proxies for depression severity: number of outpatient and inpatient depression diagnoses; PS also included other psychotropic use and health care utilization
comparison_group: Women with a depression diagnosis unexposed to antidepressants during pregnancy
population: Pregnant women enrolled in US Medicaid with live-born infants, 2000-2010
sample_size_detail: Depression-restricted cohort: 65,316 SSRI, 16,283 non-SSRI, 657,515 unexposed; full source cohort 3,789,330 pregnancies (102,179 SSRI, 26,771 non-SSRI)
rationale: PS model covariates explicitly include 'proxies for depression severity (number of outpatient and inpatient depression diagnoses)' within a depression-restricted cohort.

design_detail: Two-site, 12-week placebo-controlled RCT: sertraline plus clinical management vs interpersonal psychotherapy vs pill placebo plus clinical management; linear mixed-effects analysis
comparison_group: Pill placebo with clinical management (also IPT arm)
population: Breastfeeding and non-breastfeeding women with major depressive episode in first postpartum year, Iowa and Rhode Island
sample_size_detail: 162 randomized; number analyzed not reported in abstract
rationale: Abstract states participants 'were randomly assigned' to three arms.

design_detail: Meta-analysis of RCTs of brexanolone infusion for postpartum depression
population: Women with postpartum depression
sample_size_detail: 2 articles reporting 3 RCTs (4 active arms); 156 brexanolone, 111 placebo
rationale: Abstract: RCTs only; 3 RCTs with n = 267 pooled.

design_detail: FDA-approved Risk Evaluation and Mitigation Strategy (REMS) record for Zulresso (brexanolone)
population: Patients receiving brexanolone for postpartum depression
sample_size_detail: Regulatory web page; no study data in file
rationale: Citation-only file; FDA REMS page is a regulatory resource, not a study.

design_detail: Meta-analysis of RCTs of psychotherapies and medications vs control conditions for GAD (searches to June 2017); random effects, Hedges' g
comparison_group: Waitlist, treatment as usual, pill placebo, or psychological placebo
population: Adults with DSM-diagnosed generalized anxiety disorder (child studies excluded)
sample_size_detail: 79 RCTs; 11,002 participants
rationale: Full text: inclusion limited to RCTs; non-RCTs excluded; 79 studies with 11,002 participants.

design_detail: Clinical overview/narrative review of diagnosis and management of perinatal anxiety, informed by authors' clinical practice
population: Women with perinatal anxiety in the obstetric setting
sample_size_detail: Narrative review; no sample
rationale: Abstract describes a 'concise summary of current research' informed by clinical practice; no systematic methods.

design_detail: Meta-analytic review of randomized placebo-controlled trials of SSRIs, SNRIs, and benzodiazepines for GAD (HAM-A outcome); random effects
population: Adults with primary DSM diagnosis of GAD
sample_size_detail: 54 articles reporting 56 trials; 6,464 active (SSRI 16, SNRI 17, BZ 23 trials) and 6,191 placebo
rationale: Inclusion required randomized placebo-controlled trials; 56 trials with 12,655 participants.

design_detail: Meta-analysis (random effects) of cohort and case-control studies of first-trimester benzodiazepine exposure and major malformations/oral cleft
population: Pregnancies with first-trimester benzodiazepine exposure and their offspring
sample_size_detail: 23 studies included (of 74 retrieved); pooled participant count not reported in abstract
rationale: Title and abstract: meta-analysis of cohort and case-control studies.

design_detail: Systematic review and meta-analysis (random effects) of longitudinal studies of recurrence after first-onset postpartum psychosis
population: Women with first-onset postpartum psychosis followed >=18 months
sample_size_detail: 6 studies; 645 patients; follow-up 11-26 years
rationale: PRISMA/MOOSE systematic review of longitudinal observational studies; 6 studies, 645 patients.

design_detail: Population-based record-linkage cohort (psychiatric case register + prospective obstetric records), Western Australia 1980-1992; odds ratios for reproductive complications vs randomly selected comparison births
severity_measure: Abstract does not report covariate adjustment; exposure is the psychiatric diagnosis itself, not treatment
comparison_group: Births to women without a psychiatric diagnosis (random sample)
population: Births to women with schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, or major depression, Western Australia, 1980-1992
sample_size_detail: 3,174 births to affected women; 3,129 comparison births
rationale: Exposed-vs-comparison cohort with ORs 'calculated' but no adjustment described; also compares pregnancies before vs after diagnosis, which may or may not be within-mother.

design_detail: Prospective observational PK study (Emory) with population nonlinear mixed-effects modeling (NONMEM) of lamotrigine oral clearance across pregnancy and postpartum
comparison_group: None (within-woman change across gestation and postpartum)
population: Women treated with lamotrigine for epilepsy and/or psychiatric disorder (mostly bipolar), pregnant or planning pregnancy
sample_size_detail: 64 pregnancies; 600 LTG concentrations; 43 epilepsy, 19 psychiatric, 2 comorbid pregnancies
rationale: Drug clearance modeling study with no clinical outcome comparison.

design_detail: Population-based descriptive cohort (MEPREP: 11 US health plans incl. Tennessee Medicaid), 2001-2007; prevalence and trends of prenatal antipsychotic dispensing
severity_measure: Not applicable (descriptive prevalence; no comparative effect estimate)
comparison_group: None (descriptive comparison of characteristics with unexposed deliveries)
population: Live-born deliveries to women aged 15-45 in 11 US health plans, 2001-2007
sample_size_detail: 4,223 atypical- and 548 typical-antipsychotic-exposed deliveries
rationale: Purely descriptive prevalence and trend estimates; no outcome comparison or adjustment.

design_detail: Prospective pregnancy registry cohort (MGH National Pregnancy Registry for Atypical Antipsychotics) with medical-record confirmation; odds ratio for major malformations
severity_measure: Crude OR (1.25; 3/214 exposed vs 1/89 controls reproduces it); no covariate adjustment reported
comparison_group: Unexposed pregnant women with histories of psychiatric morbidity
population: Pregnant women aged 18-45 enrolled in MGH-based registry via provider/self-referral, through Dec 2014
sample_size_detail: 487 enrolled (353 SGA users, 134 comparison); 303 completed and analyzed: 214 first-trimester-exposed live births, 89 controls
rationale: Comparison of exposed vs psychiatric comparison group; reported OR equals the crude ratio of event counts, so no adjustment.

design_detail: Prospective longitudinal cohort (Pittsburgh, 2006-2011); repeated-measures mixed models of Bayley (BSID-II) scores at 12/26/52 weeks; Model I unadjusted, Models II-III adjusted for maternal symptom scores and selected confounders
severity_measure: SIGH-ADS (Hamilton-based depression) and Mania Rating Scale scores in Models II/III; abstract headline result is from unadjusted Model I
comparison_group: Infants of women with untreated bipolar disorder (BD-) and of women without bipolar disorder or psychotropic exposure
population: Mother-infant dyads: women with bipolar disorder treated or untreated with psychotropics in pregnancy and controls, Pittsburgh PA
sample_size_detail: 54 BD+, 27 BD-, 116 controls; substantial attrition by 52 weeks
rationale: Non-randomized exposure comparison; Model II 'added SIGH-ADS and MRS scores' to control baseline symptomatology, though the abstract emphasizes the unadjusted model.

design_detail: Descriptive surveillance report (MMWR): spina bifida incidence from 16 state population-based birth defects surveillance systems, 1983-1990
population: Births in 16 US states with population-based birth defects surveillance, 1983-1990
sample_size_detail: Not reported (abstract truncated)
rationale: Abstract describes incidence and descriptive epidemiology from surveillance data; abstract truncated so detail is limited.

design_detail: Retrospective cohort, 4 Dutch provinces, children born 1972-1992 to mothers with epilepsy using AEDs in first trimester vs nonepileptic matched controls; relative risks by AED regimen and dose
severity_measure: Controls matched but matching/adjustment variables not stated in abstract; no seizure-severity measure mentioned
comparison_group: Nonepileptic matched controls (plus comparisons across AED regimens)
population: Children born 1972-1992 in four Netherlands provinces to mothers with epilepsy on first-trimester AEDs
sample_size_detail: 1,411 exposed children; 2,000 nonepileptic matched controls
rationale: Matched-control cohort counts as adjusted (matching), but covariate set is unavailable and the comparator lacks the indication.

design_detail: Prospective single-center cohort (San Paolo Hospital, Milan) of pregnancies in women with epilepsy since 1977; descriptive malformation rates
severity_measure: No adjustment reported; descriptive rates only
population: Pregnancies in women with epilepsy followed at San Paolo Hospital, Milan, from 1977
sample_size_detail: 517 pregnancies followed; 25 untreated
rationale: Results report crude malformation rates with no comparative modeling described.

design_detail: Narrative review of animal and human evidence on teratogenic effects of anticonvulsants with clinical recommendations
population: Pregnant women/fetuses exposed to anticonvulsants (animal and human data)
sample_size_detail: Narrative review; no sample
rationale: Abstract summarizes animal and human literature and gives advice without systematic methods or original data.

design_detail: Case-control study within Spanish Collaborative Study of Congenital Malformations (ECEMC) surveillance; OR for limb deficiencies after first-trimester valproate, adjusted for potential confounders
severity_measure: Abstract says 'after controlling for potential confounder factors' without listing them; no epilepsy-severity measure mentioned
population: Malformed and control newborns in ECEMC Spanish hospital-based surveillance
sample_size_detail: 22,294 malformed and 21,937 control infants with AED data; 57 malformed and 10 control infants VPA-exposed; 3 exposed with limb deficiencies
rationale: Adjusted case-control analysis, but covariates are not reported in the file.

design_detail: Letter to the editor (J Pediatr 1983) on possible valproate teratogenicity; no abstract in file, design inferred from title and publication type
population: Infants exposed to valproate in utero (per title)
sample_size_detail: Not reported; file has metadata only (no abstract)
rationale: Only the title and PubMed type 'Letter' are available; a letter reporting a 'possible teratogenic effect' most plausibly describes exposed case(s).

design_detail: Case report of two valproate-exposed siblings with long-term follow-up plus literature review compiling VPA-monotherapy-exposed cases, 1978-2000
population: Children with prenatal valproic acid monotherapy exposure (fetal valproate syndrome)
sample_size_detail: 2 new sibling cases described; phenotype frequencies based on 69 literature-identified cases
rationale: Exposed cases described without a comparison group; 'siblings' are the case subjects, not a within-family exposure contrast.

design_detail: Clinical case series of children with fetal anticonvulsant syndromes ascertained via a parent support association and a genetics service; questionnaire, interview, and examination
population: Children with fetal anticonvulsant syndromes (Fetal Anticonvulsant Syndrome Association and Aberdeen Medical Genetics Service)
sample_size_detail: 52 via support association, 5 via genetics referral
rationale: Descriptive clinical series of 57 exposed, affected children with no comparison group.

design_detail: Unselected case series of valproate-exposed infants of mothers with epilepsy; descriptive outcomes with within-series dose relationships
population: Infants born to mothers with epilepsy exposed to valproate during pregnancy
sample_size_detail: 17 exposed infants
rationale: Abstract: 'An unselected series is presented of 17 infants' exposed to valproate; no unexposed comparison.

design_detail: AIUM practice parameter for the performance of fetal echocardiography (no abstract in file)
population: Pregnant patients/fetuses undergoing fetal echocardiography
sample_size_detail: Practice parameter; no sample
rationale: Title and PubMed type 'Practice Guideline' identify a practice parameter; file contains metadata only.

design_detail: Prospective placental-passage study (maternal and cord blood lithium at delivery) pooled with published cases; associations of delivery lithium concentration with perinatal outcomes
comparison_group: None (internal comparisons by delivery lithium concentration and by pre-delivery withholding)
population: Pregnant women treated with lithium through delivery and their infants
sample_size_detail: 10 prospectively studied participants + 32 published cases (pooled)
rationale: Primary aim is cord-to-maternal lithium ratio (placental passage); outcome comparisons are unadjusted and concentration-based.

design_detail: Retrospective cohort, US Medicaid Analytic eXtract 2000-2007, restricted to women with mood/anxiety disorder diagnoses; GEE relative risks with multivariable adjustment plus hdPS sensitivity analysis
severity_measure: Number of outpatient and inpatient mood/anxiety disorder diagnoses (labeled severity proxies); also other psychotropics and health care use
comparison_group: Women with mood/anxiety disorders and no antidepressant supply in the 5 months before delivery
population: Pregnant women aged 12-55 in US Medicaid with mood/anxiety disorder diagnoses and live births, 2000-2007
sample_size_detail: 106,000 mood/anxiety subcohort minus 3,278 polytherapy; 69,044 unexposed, 29,222 SRI monotherapy (12,710 current), 4,456 non-SRI (1,495 current)
rationale: Fully adjusted models include 'proxies of mood/anxiety disorder severity' (outpatient and inpatient diagnosis counts) in a diagnosis-restricted cohort.

design_detail: Prospective national register-based birth cohort, Finland 1996-2010; cumulative incidence and hazard ratios for SSRI-exposed vs unmedicated vs unexposed offspring
severity_measure: Comparator restricted by diagnosis (unmedicated mothers with depression-related disorders); abstract does not report covariates or severity measures
comparison_group: Offspring of mothers with depression-related psychiatric disorders without SSRI purchases (unmedicated); also unexposed offspring
population: Singleton offspring in Finnish national registers, 1996-2010, followed to age 14
sample_size_detail: 15,596 SSRI-exposed, 9,537 unmedicated, 31,207 unexposed; sampling frame 845,345 pregnant women
rationale: Non-randomized comparison with an active-indication comparator, but the abstract never states covariate adjustment, so adjustment status and severity are uncertain.
